sloka: ततस्ते कारणं सर्वं तदा शापं च वालिनः ।शशंसुर्वानरास्सर्वे वालिने हेममालिने ॥४-११-६१॥।।
transliteration: tataste kāraṇaṁ sarvaṁ tadā śāpaṁ ca vālinaḥ ।śaśaṁsurvānarāssarve vāline hemamāline ॥4-11-61॥।।

translations.english: 'Then all the monkeys collected together and narrated everything about the curse given to Vali , adorned with a golden chain(on his neck).
